muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and put in the accusative by its apodosis, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿علمت نفس﴾.
﴿السماء﴾: fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb indicated by the one mentioned, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma. The clause made of the omitted verb and the fāʿil is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's annexation to it.
﴿انفطرت﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, its implied form being "hiya", and the tāʾ is for the feminine. The clause ﴿انفطرت﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position. The adverb is attached to the apodosis (jawāb), which is ﴿عَلِمَتْ﴾.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and idhā is an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and put in the accusative by its apodosis.
﴿الكواكب﴾: fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it; the fāʿil is nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma. The clause made of the omitted verb and the fāʿil is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's annexation to it.
﴿انتثرت﴾: intathara is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, its implied form being "hiya", and the tāʾ is for the feminine. The clause intatharat is explicative, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and idhā is an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and put in the accusative by its apodosis.
﴿البحار﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it. The clause made of the omitted verb and the nāʾib fāʿil is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's annexation to it.
﴿فجرت﴾: fujjira is a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with a latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil, its implied form being "hiya", and the tāʾ is for the feminine. The clause ﴿فجرت﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and idhā is an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and put in the accusative by its apodosis.
﴿القبور﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it; the nāʾib fāʿil is nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma. The clause made of the omitted verb and the nāʾib fāʿil is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's annexation to it.
﴿بعثرت﴾: a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with a latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil, its implied form being "hiya", and the tāʾ is for the feminine. The clause ﴿بعثرت﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿علمت﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the tāʾ is for the feminine.
﴿نفس﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قدمت﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "hiya".
﴿و﴾: the wāw is a conjunction.
﴿أخرت﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "hiya". The clause ﴿علمت نفس﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿قدمت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿أخرت﴾ is conjoined to ﴿قدمت﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle.
﴿أيها﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الإنسان﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿غرك﴾: gharra is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "huwa", and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بربك﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and the word ﴿رب﴾ is a genitive noun by the kasra; the kāf is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿غرك﴾.
﴿الكريم﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ربك﴾, genitive. The clause ﴿يا أيها...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿ما غرك﴾ is the answer to the vocative, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿غرك﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as a second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ربك﴾.
﴿خلقك﴾: ﴿خلق﴾ is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فسواك﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and sawwāka is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa; the fāʿil is a pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فعدلك﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ʿadalaka is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa; the fāʿil is a pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿خلقك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿سواك﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خلقك﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿عدلك﴾ is conjoined to ﴿سواك﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿في﴾: a preposition.
﴿أي﴾: a noun in the genitive by the preposition ﴿في﴾, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ركبك﴾.
﴿صورة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿ما﴾: connective (ṣila).
﴿شاء﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun, its implied form being "huwa".
﴿ركبك﴾: rakkaba is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa; the fāʿil is a pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿شاء﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿صورة﴾, and the clause ﴿ركبك﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of khalaqaka, sawwāka and ʿadalaka.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿بل﴾: a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī).
﴿تكذبون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿بالدين﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and al-dīn is a genitive noun by the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تكذبون﴾. The clause ﴿تكذبون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿و﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿إن﴾: a particle of emphasis and accusative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿عليكم﴾: ʿalā is a preposition and ﴿كم﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿لحافظين﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and ḥāfiẓīn is the postponed noun (ism) of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause ﴿إن عليكم لحافظين﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of tukadhdhibūn; or the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿كراما﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حافظين﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿كاتبين﴾: a second naʿt, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿يعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿تفعلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. The clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as another naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حافظين﴾, and the clause ﴿تفعلون﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿إن﴾: a particle of emphasis and accusative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿الأبرار﴾: the noun (ism) of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿لفي﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis, and fī is a preposition.
﴿نعيم﴾: a noun in the genitive by the preposition ﴿في﴾, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. The clause ﴿إن الأبرار لفي نعيم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and inna is a particle of emphasis and accusative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿الفجار﴾: the noun (ism) of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿لفي﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis, and fī is a preposition.
﴿جحيم﴾: a noun in the genitive by the preposition ﴿في﴾, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. The clause ﴿إن الفجار لفي جحيم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿إن الأبرار لفي نعيم﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿يصلونها﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), and ﴿ها﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يوم﴾: an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿الدين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the kasra. The clause ﴿يصلونها﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in the implied khabar (predicate) of inna; it is also said to be in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿جحيم﴾. Yawm is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصلونها﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿و﴾: the wāw is a conjunction.
﴿ما﴾: a negative particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn that works like laysa.
﴿هم﴾: a detached pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the noun (ism) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿عنها﴾: ʿan is a preposition, and ﴿ها﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿غائبين﴾.
﴿بغائبين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ghāʾibīn is a noun genitive in form by the yāʾ and accusative by position as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾. The clause ﴿ما هم بغائبين﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in ﴿يصلونها﴾.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿و﴾: the wāw is resumptive.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أدراك﴾: a past verb indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and the kāf is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿يوم﴾: khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿الدين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the kasra. The clause ﴿ما أدراك﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿أدراك﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the first ﴿ما﴾; and the interrogative clause ﴿ما يوم الدين﴾ is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the second and third objects of the verb ﴿أدراك﴾, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أدراك﴾: a past verb indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and the kāf is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿يوم﴾: khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿الدين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the kasra. The interrogative clause ﴿ما يوم الدين﴾ is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the second and third objects of the verb ﴿أدراك﴾, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; and the second clause ﴿ما أدراك﴾ is conjoined to the first clause ﴿ما أدراك﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿يوم﴾: an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "yujāzūn" (they will be requited) or "udhkur" (mention).
﴿لا﴾: a negative particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿تملك﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿نفس﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿لنفس﴾: the lām is a preposition and nafs is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تملك﴾.
﴿شيئا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿والأمر﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and al-amr is mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿يومئذ﴾: yawm: an adverb of time, accusative by the fatḥa, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of al-amr; idh: a noun indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause.
﴿لله﴾: the lām is a preposition, and the Name of Majesty is a noun in the genitive by the lām, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of al-amr. The clause ﴿لا تملك﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause ﴿الأمر يومئذ لله﴾ is in the position of the accusative of [Translator's note: the source appears to omit the word "ḥāl" here, i.e. "a ḥāl of"] the fāʿil of ﴿تملك﴾, the linking element being implied, i.e. "fīhi" (in it).
